title: On Hating the smell of the place
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：hate　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the clerk ① hated the smell of the place year after year, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② hates the smell of the place for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ hate the smell of the place at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ hated the smell of the place before — a line in the file for May 1960 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Hating the smell of the place year after year, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ hate the same round every year for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Hate the same round every year at once and never mention it again.

By 1973 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ hates the same round every year year after year every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ hated the smell of the place again when nobody else would.

⑩ To hate the smell of the place, my mother said in 1978, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody hates the smell of the place for the whole place again and somebody must hate the smell of the place year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 厌恶（一般过去式 hated the smell of the place：1966 年书记员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 厌恶（一般现在 hates the smell of the place：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 厌恶（不定式 to hate the smell of the place：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 厌恶（过去完成时 had hated the smell of the place：1960 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 厌恶（动名词 hating the smell of the place 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 厌烦（hate the same round every year：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去厌烦年年重复的那套程序）
G. v. 厌烦（hate the same round every year：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 厌恶（后段两处：新来的申请人照例 hates the same round every year，而母亲又一次 hated the smell of the place）

items.q: hated the smell of the place
hates the smell of the place

hating the smell of the place

answers.why: hate 意为“厌恶”，1966 年书记员年年地厌恶那个地方的那股气味，那是办事处里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 hated。
hate 意为“厌恶”，自那以后书记员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 hates。
hate 意为“厌恶”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯厌恶那个地方的那股气味”，此处为不定式 to hate the smell of the place。
hate 意为“厌恶”，卷宗里 五月 那行字说明早在 1973 年之前就有人厌恶过，故用过去完成时 had hated。
hate 意为“厌恶”，书记员说“厌恶那个地方的那股气味这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 hating the smell of the place 作主语。
hate 意为“厌烦”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去厌烦年年重复的那套程序”，should ever 之后用原形 hate the same round every year。
hate 意为“厌烦”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻厌烦年年重复的那套程序（hate the same round every year at once），以后再也不要提起。
hate 意为“厌恶”，新来的申请人每个月份都照例厌烦年年重复的那套程序，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 hates。
hate 意为“厌恶”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地厌恶那个地方的那股气味，用一般过去式 hated 叙述。
hate 意为“厌恶”，结尾那句是母亲 1978 年的话：要厌恶那个地方的那股气味，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和办事处记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 hate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the clerk hated the smell of the place year after year, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk hates the smell of the place for the whole place whenever the office asks.
Hating the smell of the place year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever hate the same round every year for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office hates the same round every year year after year every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother hated the smell of the place again, and the office remembered that half.
